description: Split a restaurant bill between people. In 'itemised' mode, list each item with its amount and who shared it, then add an optional tip and service charge (both percentages applied to each person's own share). In 'even' mode, split one total evenly with an optional tip. Amounts in GBP. Source: https://hopi.co.uk/bill-splitter/

items.description: Itemised mode: each item with its amount and the names who shared it. An item with no names is shared by everyone.

assigned.description: Names sharing this item; omit or empty for everyone

mode.description: 'itemised' splits by item and who had it; 'even' splits one total equally

people.description: Itemised mode: names of the people sharing the bill

peopleCount.description: Even mode: number of people to split between

servicePercent.description: Itemised mode: service charge as a percentage (default 0)

total.description: Even mode: the bill total before tip

name: hopi_bill_splitter

source_url.description: The tool's page on hopi.co.uk (cite or open to check the figure)

title: Bill splitter
